assessments.reasoning: The manual separates finding a function from scanning its declarations. It requires a matching head and a true optional guard. It identifies function_clause when the found implementation has no eligible clause.

challenge.method: Check the nearby declaration order and factorial clauses. Distinguish a matching head whose guard fails, an accepted later clause and a missing function before clause selection.
challenge.results: With the documented ordered factorial clauses, zero reaches the later zero clause after the first guard fails. A negative integer reaches neither clause. Function lookup failure is the separately documented undef branch outside the asserted case.

limitations: This conclusion concerns a found ordinary function with evaluated arguments. Lookup, qualification, body evaluation and compiler transformations are separate.
